name: Corpo e Meio, de Sandro Aguilar + As Sereias, de Paulo Rocha + Cinema, de Fernando Lopes
description: A film screening featuring works by Sandro Aguilar, Paulo Rocha, and Fernando Lopes exploring the Douro and the city of Porto.
longDescription:
Part of the Porto/Post/Doc Film & Media Festival, this screening under the Entre Imagens cycle brings together three films: Corpo e Meio by Sandro Aguilar, As Sereias by Paulo Rocha, and Cinema by Fernando Lopes. The programme connects cinema with the Douro and Porto, focusing on landscape, celebration, memory, and a city undergoing transformation.

The session takes place at Batalha Centro de Cinema on 21 November 2026 at 21:45. Tickets cost 5 euros, with discounts available for Cartão Porto holders, and entry is rated 12+.
